Surface reservoir storage.provides: visible declining storage, months of warning, vulnerable to evaporation

Confined groundwater aquifer.provides: buffered against a single dry season, recharge over decades, no visible indicator to the public

River abstraction.requires: a licence to take flow directly
River abstraction.provides: immediate response to rainfall, competition with ecological flow, no storage buffer at all

Desalination plant.requires: coastal intake and very large electrical supply
Desalination plant.provides: independence from rainfall entirely, high unit cost, months to commission

Household consumption.provides: politically sensitive, modest total volume, responsive to tariffs and messaging

Irrigated agriculture.provides: the largest volume by far, seasonal timing, livelihood consequences

Industrial process water.provides: continuous demand, employment consequences, some recycling possible

Power station cooling.provides: non-substitutable within the plant, loss of generation if curtailed

Tariff increase.requires: a metered supply and a billing relationship
Tariff increase.provides: demand reduction through price, regressive impact, no effect on unmetered users

Rota supply by zone.provides: enforced volume reduction, contamination risk on repressurisation

Ban on non-essential use.provides: rapid modest saving, dependence on compliance

Emergency inter-basin transfer.requires: an existing pipeline or canal to another basin
Emergency inter-basin transfer.provides: import of volume, transfer of the shortage elsewhere

Supply interruption by zone.provides: intermittent service, public health risk from contamination
